QuestInfo.name: The Mystery of Naora Hospital
QuestInfo.0: Jane Doe is shocked to learn that she's dead.
QuestInfo.1: It turns out #p1052105# in Naora Hospital is a ghost. Nella doesn't REALLY need to know that, does she?
QuestInfo.2: You told Nella that there weren't any ghosts in Naora Hospital. Did she really believe you? Or was she just pretending?

0.0: I'm too y-young to be a ghost... P-please, don't let anyone know I'm here...! I have to find a way to come back to life...!\r\n#L0##bNah, you should just head on up to the afterlife now. (Tell Nella the rumors are false. She probably couldn't handle the truth...)#l\n#k
0.1: H-how rude...! How would you like it if YOU were a ghost...?

1.0: Well? What'd you find out? Is there a ghost in Naora Hospital?

yes.0: Ha! I knew it wasn't true! Good job. We'll be in touch.
